profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a mechanical engineer turned software engineer with nearly a decade of experience collaborating on large multidisciplinary projects. I enjoy learning new skills and engaging in complex problem solving.

positions.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
positions.description: Performed energy load, airflow balancing, and equipment sizing calculations to design and spec efficient and reliable HVAC systems for critical lab spaces in state of the art bio-technology facilities. Carried out construction administration services to drive projects to completion. Reviewed and approved cost savings efforts, conducted periodic site visits to ensure construction is carried out per design intent, resolved on-site issues that arose by collaborating with engineers of all disciplines to find solutions.

positions.title: Energy Engineer
positions.description: Provided energy audits and retro-commissioning services for major hospital networks throughout the country. Conducted thorough facility investigations, including analyzing utility data, equipment inspections, and equipment control strategy evaluations. Developed comprehensive facility condition reports that outlined results and proposed potential capital project upgrades along with their cost savings analysis.
